title: ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the 2025 Citywide Parks Needs Assessment (PNA).
text:
[Council File 25-1538]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the 2025 Citywide Parks Needs Assessment (PNA).
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report dated December 18, 2025, attached to the Council file, relative to the 2025 Citywide PNA.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For: Downtown Los Angeles Neighborhood Council
summary: Report on the 2025 Citywide Park Needs Assessment and updates to the Public Recreation Plan and Municipal Code regarding park classifications and funding radii.
